en: The bone belongs to one dog. It is the ___ bone.
One dog owns the bone, so we add ’s: dog’s.
Two girls each have a bag. They are the ___ bags.
There are many girls, so the apostrophe goes after the s: girls’.

en.title: Whose is it?
en.teach: An apostrophe shows who something belongs to. One owner: add ’s (the dog’s bone). Many owners ending in s: add just ’ (the girls’ bags).
